_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every GetInRoute app link on the website.
frontend/src/config/apps.js derives the UI view-model from this file, and
scripts/sync-site-apps.mjs regenerates the static page's app blocks from it.
Add an App Store / TestFlight URL by setting iosUrl; the iPhone button
enables itself automatically. While iosUrl is null the button stays disabled
and no placeholder URL is ever rendered.
NEW FLAGS (Stage A4):
status       'available' | 'coming-soon'. Drives the homepage card state.
School and Parent ship as 'coming-soon' until you flip them;
flipping to 'available' needs no code change.
playUrl      Google Play listing URL. When set it REPLACES the direct-APK
button on Android with a 'Get it on Google Play' button,
automatically. Leave null to keep serving the hosted APK.
downloadPage In-app route for the per-app smart download page (QR +
device detection). One page per app, shared QR target.
version/versionCode mirror mobile/app.config.js. Bump them with
scripts/bump-version.ps1 - it updates both files together.
APK size is NOT stored here: sync-site-apps.mjs measures the real file in
backend/binaries so the number on the page can never go stale.
pwaPath       Path to the installable web app for iPhone. null until Stage B
ships it; while null the iPhone install path stays disabled so
no button ever points at something that does not exist yet.
